# Repositories that carry a copy of a script template, one per line: `owner/name template`.
# `template` is a directory of .github/script-templates. Each file the template's template.json lists must be
# byte-identical in the repository at the commit its default branch points to (script-family-check.yml).
# The per-repository data a template reads (its baseline) is not part of the template and is not compared.
